contract: One authored activity throws a retryable RuntimeException on attempt one and returns a distinct typed result on attempt two. Retry keeps the original run, activity execution, command sequence, arguments, queue and idempotency identity; it creates a distinct task and attempt, preserves the closed first-attempt failure and original retry relationship, and cannot claim before its durably recorded one-second backoff deadline. No intermediate workflow resume or terminal ActivityFailed is committed. Only attempt two resolves the activity and workflow. Preserve exact int64 types and immutable duplicate failure/completion receipts with unchanged durable history. This fixture covers reported application failure followed by success, not lease-expiry recovery, terminal/non-retryable failures, timeout retries, cancellation or workflow/child retry policies.
